PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday SEPTEMBER 13, 2018
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French
Commissioners Avery, Olvera, and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar
7A. Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of August 9, 2018
7A
7B. 2018 Ten-Year Capital Improvement Plan (CIP)
City of Palmdale Public Works Department, Applicant
Review of potential fiscal year 2018-2019 Capital Improvement Plan conformance with the City of Palmdale General Plan.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-029 finding that the City of Palmdale’s 2018 Ten-Year Capital Improvement Plan is in conformance with the City of Palmdale General Plan and Government Code Section 65103. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
7B
8. Public Hearings
8A. Conditional Use Permit 17-019 and Site Plan Review 18-024
Eukon Group, Applicant
A request to construct a major telecommunications facility designed as faux water tank located at 38848 25th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-033 approving a request to establish a minor communications facility and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Conditional Use Permit 18-005 and Site Plan Review 18-025
Delta Engineering Group, Applicant
A request to construct a major telecommunications facility designed as roof tower elements with an approximately 140 square foot equipment enclosure located at 1529 East Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-032 approving a request to establish a minor communications facility and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8B
9. Staff Communications Development Update
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
